_comment: A bundle is either a rule (membership computed from derived attributes, so new policies join automatically) or curated (an explicit list, for opinionated sets like Autopilot MVP). A bundle can be both: rule matches are unioned with 'include' and then 'exclude' is subtracted. 'path' drives the Building Blocks wizard drill-down.

bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 1
bundles.description: Every Windows policy aligned to CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark Level 1. New CIS L1 policies join automatically on commit.

bundles.name: Windows - CIS Level 2
bundles.description: Windows policies aligned to CIS Level 2. Layer on top of L1; expect higher user impact.

bundles.name: Windows - CDW Standard Baseline
bundles.description: The CDW-authored Windows baseline. Everything not tagged to an external framework.

bundles.name: Windows - Defender Antivirus
bundles.description: All Windows antivirus and Defender configuration, regardless of framework.

bundles.name: Entra - Core Conditional Access
bundles.description: The baseline Conditional Access set: admin MFA, risk-based password change, legacy auth block.

bundles.name: Windows - Autopilot Minimum Viable
bundles.description: The smallest policy set required to stand up Windows Autopilot enrolment for a new customer. Curated by the practice, not derived. Review at each benchmark release.
